design.currentState: No token usage tracking exists. Pi reports usage in turn_end events but discards it after each session.
design.desiredState: Extension that records every turn usage to ~/.config/pi/usage.jsonl and shows aggregated stats via /usage command (day/week/month, per model, per project).
design.patterns: Follow pi-notify pattern for agent_end/turn_end hooks. Use SdkTurnEndMessage local interface for untyped usage fields. Use @pi-ext/shared formatTokens for display. DI pattern (createExtension) for testability.
design.decisions: JSONL over SQLite (simplicity). turn_end over agent_end for data (usage lives on message, not event). One entry per turn (granular aggregation). Global file with project labels (not per-project files).
